_about: Rule rows for the LOD Upgrade pack 'Layers' (bim-ootb prompts/MODELLER_LOD_UPGRADE_PILL.md section 3 and P3 SPEC). Constants of the extractor's layer split (BIMCompiler DAGCompiler/python/extractIFCtoDB.py), kept as data. Every row: value, unit, source. A stated value always wins over a default. Change a row, re-run; no code change. No project values are kept in this file.

layer_tol_mm.source: default: extractor LAYER_TOL (boundary and extent alignment tolerance of the layer split)

layer_sum_tol_mm.source: default: extractor LAYER_SUM_TOL (the authored layer thicknesses must re-sum to the authored total)

layer_volume_rtol.source: default: extractor LAYER_VOL_RTOL (the slab volumes must re-sum to the envelope volume)

layer_min_count.source: default: extractor (a layer set is split only when the usage declares more than one layer)
